name: @tentoroforge/editor-scripts
description: What the editor's own Node scripts import. Declared HERE, beside the scripts, because that is where Node resolves from: in a container /app/static has no repo root above it to borrow from, so the editor could not read a single page — 'Cannot find package @babel/parser imported from /app/static/react-model.mjs' (UAT, both stacks, 2026-09-21).
